notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5.6.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/68d2e7669099db924c217badaefc65a590002f60.png[/img][b][/b][b]Version 1.5.6.6[/b] ([b]Server Version: 1.5.6.150[/b] | [b]Client Version: 2.0.0.156[/b])
[b]Release Date: February 20, 2025[/b]

[h2][i][b]MAJOR HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/i][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][NEW][/b] Introducing Loot Quality Bonus System - Players now have a chance to obtain items with (1 or 2) bonus stats during drops
[*] [b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Channel Selection System has been reintegrated into the character selection screen
[*] [b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Collision system reworked - Players can now pass through other players while mounted or running
[*] [b][SECURITY][/b] All client executable files are now digitally signed - This resolves previous antivirus detection issues
[/list]
[h2]DUNGEONS & RAIDS[/h2]
[h3]Boss Encounters[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][BALANCE] Wu Zhein[/b]
[list]
[*] Maximum entry level cap implemented at level 160
[*] Added cooldown timer between attempts
[/list][*] [b][FIX][/b] Black Dragon entrance requirements now properly enforced at level 65
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Boss region boundaries adjusted for:
[list]
[*] Dragon Lord
[*] Black Dragon
[*] Reaper Crypt[/list]
[*] [b][BALANCE] Reaper God[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed "Beasts" stereotype vulnerab[b][/b]ility - Beast-type damage bonuses no longer affect Reaper God
[/list]
[*] [b][BALANCE] Spider Queen[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased aggro range for better combat engagement
[/list][/list][h3]Dungeon Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Naga Palace
[list]
[*] Level design enhanced for better gameplay flow
[*] Added Teleport Indicator above "Dragon God High Priest" dungeon initiator
[/list]
[*] [b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Cursed Warlord map received comprehensive level design updates
[*] [b][BALANCE][/b] Blue Guivres in Minotaur Fortress will no longer grant elevated HXP
[/list]
[h2][b]CLASS CHANGES[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Petrun[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Blade Energy
[list]
[*] Enhanced HP Stealing mechanics
[*] Improved Hitting Power Boost effectiveness
[/list]
[*] [b][NERF][/b] Magical Armor
[list]
[*] Defense value has been reduced
[/list]
[*] [b][NERF][/b] Fear ability
[list]
[*] Defense value has been reduced
[/list][/list][h3][b]Mage[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][NERF][/b] Lightning Summon
[list]
[*] Stun duration NERFED from 2.5s to 1.1s
[*] Added percentage-based stun bonus chance
[/list][/list][h3][b]Dorhan[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Corrected tooltip information for a level 5 ability incorrectly showing level 35 requirement
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Fixed Bash ability dealing damage at unintended ranges
[/list]
[h2]COMBAT & ABILITIES[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] All buff abilities now consume mana throughout their duration
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Fixed double damage occurrence when pressing spacebar to attack followed by quick "W" key press
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Resolved issue with ranged archers becoming invulnerable when pulled outside spawn areas
[/list]
[h2]SYSTEMS & MECHANICS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Hero Point cap increased from 32,767
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Quest-related item duplication exploit resolved
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Fixed inventory stacking issues beyond page 5 in buffgrid area
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Storage page expansion issues resolved for pages beyond 5
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Fixed issue allowing players to mount while dead
[/list]
[h2]UI/UX IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Character window visual design updated
[*] [b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Teleporter welcome window GUI redesigned
[*] [b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Default teleporter names now properly reflect area names
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Loading screen tip texts now display correctly
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Fixed stuck tooltip issue when rapidly left-clicking inventory items
[/list]
[h2]WORLD & ENVIRONMENT[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Wolf Shaman Forest
[list]
[*] Fixed underground spawning issue at initial teleport
[*] Corrected visual error causing title misalignment in world atlas
[/list]
[*] [b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Witch Queen Boss Area
[list]
[*] Replaced 2x Witch Warriors with 1x Witch Warrior and 1x Savage Witch Warrior
[*] Reinstated Hasnail Druid for quest requirements
[/list]
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Character floating issue while descending from elevated areas resolved
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Lost Empire area now properly requires level 65 to enter
[/list]
[h2]LOCALIZATION[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Corrected English quest texts containing 'Minimum szint'
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Fixed Witch Queen quest description for "Kill 20 white wolves"
[/list]
[h2]CLIENT & LAUNCHER[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][FIX][/b] Patch Notes link in Laniatus Launcher now functioning properly
[/list]
[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]
[list]
[*] We are actively monitoring and working on resolving various reported issues
[*] Please report any bugs through our official channels
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/playm2m][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/e7b33b5568c69e6702a2324aedd1ed9d76c1d40d.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5.6.5
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.5.6: Awakening of Legends
February 15, 2025[/h1]

[h3]Welcome, Heroes! Update 1.5.6 brings comprehensive improvements to combat mechanics, enhanced world design, competitive gameplay features, and various quality-of-life changes to enrich your journey through the realm.[/h3]

[h2]HIGHLIGHTS[/h2]
[h3][b][NEW] Battleground Arena System[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] Revolutionary e-sports arena implementation
[*] Support for up to 200 players in Last Man Standing mode
[*] Up to 40 players in standard arena matches
[*] Complete team management system
[*] Random team matchmaking functionality
[/olist]
[h2][MAJOR IMPROVEMENT] Combat System Overhaul[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Enhanced NPC targeting mechanics
[*] Improved boss encounter dynamics
[*] Refined combat feedback systems
[/olist]
[h2][u][b][ENHANCEMENT] World Design Updates[/b][/u][/h2]
[olist]
[*] Comprehensive zone redesigns
[*] Enhanced environmental details
[*] Improved NPC and monster placement
[/olist]
[h2]COMBAT SYSTEMS[/h2]
[b][FIX] Core Combat Mechanics[/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed unlimited hits exploit with "SPACE" in character attack
[*] Resolved character attack animation stutter during auto-attack sequences
[*] Corrected attack combo issues with consecutive hits
[*] Implemented "No valid target" suppression message for server-calculated attacks
[*] Fixed auto-attack related issues requiring temporary removal
[*] Improved VFX synchronization and timing
[/olist]
[h2][IMPROVEMENT] NPC Combat Behavior[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Enhanced NPC focus on initial attackers
[*] Refined group leader threat calculations
[*] Improved group member threat sensitivity
[*] Maintained target persistence after group leader defeat
[*] Implemented sophisticated threat management system
[/olist]
[h2][BALANCE] Defense System Overhaul[/h2]
[olist]
[*] NEW FORMULA: Defense = (Dexterity × 10) + 10 + (Level ÷ 2)
[*] Reduced overall defense values for improved combat balance
[*] Adjusted scaling for better progression curve
[/olist]
[h2][ENHANCEMENT] Boss Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] INCREASED: Knockdown duration for Harkoon and Alisa-type bosses (0.7s → 7.0s)
[*] IMPROVED: Wu Zhein Boss combat statistics and behavior
[*] ENHANCED: Boss arena navigation and targeting systems
[*] ADDED: Clear target zone indicators for boss encounters
[/list]
[h2]CLASS ADJUSTMENTS[/h2]
[b][FIX] Petrun Class[/b]
[olist]
[*] Resolved Black Orb ability's 0.83ms pre-damage delay
[*] Fixed ability timing calculations
[*] Improved damage application consistency
[/olist]
[b][FIX] Dorhan Class[/b]
[olist]
[*] Corrected Triple Slash to properly apply damage three times
[*] Enhanced ability synchronization
[*] Fixed damage calculation issues
[/olist]
[b][FIX] Ability Systems[/b]
[olist]
[*] Corrected Stunning Blade ability's 'Sword Energy' VFX at level 1
[*] Fixed Bravery Cape cooldown (Increased by 10 seconds)
[*] Resolved creature teleportation issues with specific abilities
[/olist]
[h2]WORLD CONTENT[/h2]
[b][MAJOR IMPROVEMENT] Lost Empire[/b]
[olist]
[*] Complete area redesign and enhancement
[*] Added NPC and monster visibility to Atlas
[*] Improved navigation pathways
[*] Enhanced environmental details
[/olist]
[h2][IMPROVEMENT] Capital Palace[/h2]
[list]
[*] Extensive architectural improvements
[*] FIXED: Texture and specular ratio issues
[*] RESOLVED: Freeze when approaching stable area
[*] ENHANCED: Overall visual fidelity
[*] ADJUSTED: Environmental lighting
[/list]
[h2][ENHANCEMENT] Witch Queen's Area[/h2]
[b]Refined boss arena mechanics and navigation
[/b][list]
[*] REMOVED: Misplaced Hasnail Druid NPC
[*] ADDED: Storekeeper to district castle
[*] FIXED: Nested monster spawning issues
[*] IMPROVED: Object visibility
[*] ADDED: Angry Forest Archer to Atlas
[*] INCREASED: LOD levels for better visibility
[/list]
[h2][FIX] Wolf Shaman Forest[/h2]
[b]Corrected terrain configuration issues
[/b][list]
[*] REMOVED: Free portal to Witch Queen zone
[*] ADDED: Hunter to Atlas system
[*] IMPROVED: Monster pathing
[*] ENHANCED: Environmental consistency
[/list]
[h2][IMPROVEMENT] Specific Zone Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dark Order Temple: Adjusted level design and accessibility
[*] Land of the Dead: Enhanced Atlas with NPC and mob visibility
[*] Light Order: Implemented complete Atlas system with NPC visibility
[/list]
[b]Capital City - Zorandor:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed teleport district collisions
[*] Resolved texture issues
[*] Improved performance optimization
[/list]
[b]Cursed Warlord:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added mob visibility to Atlas
[*] Introduced Storekeeper to safe district
[*] Enhanced navigation paths
[/list]
[b]Minotaur Fortress:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Guivre mobs to Atlas
[*] Improved monster placement
[/list]
[b]Tutorial Island:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced mob visibility in Atlas
[*] Improved new player experience
[/list]
[b]Spider Dungeon:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Atlas systems
[*] Enhanced mob visibility
[*] Improved pathing
[/list]
[h2]MONSTER & NPC UPDATES
[/h2][BALANCE] Enemy Adjustments
[b]Robber Archer:
[/b]
[list]
[*] REDUCED: Overall aggression
[*] DECREASED: Attack damage
[*] ADJUSTED: Combat behavior patterns
[*] MODIFIED: Engagement range
[/list]
[b]Angry Forest Archer (NEW):[/b]
[list]
[*] INCREASED: Combat capabilities
[*] ENHANCED: Resilience
[*] ADDED: Advanced AI patterns
[*] IMPLEMENTED: Strategic positioning behavior
[/list]
[b][FIX] NPC Systems[/b]
[olist]
[*] Corrected DragonGod NPC localization issues
[*] Fixed quest-giver interaction mechanics
[*] Improved merchant functionality and accessibility
[*] Enhanced NPC placement logic
[/olist]
[h2][ENHANCEMENT] Monster Behavior[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Improved combat engagement patterns
[*] Enhanced pathing algorithms
[*] Refined aggro radius calculations
[*] Updated spawn point distribution
[/olist]
[h1]ITEMS & ECONOMY
[/h1][h2][UPDATE] Item System Changes[/h2]
[b]RENAMED:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ice Piece → Acrylith
[*] Ice Ball → Moonstone
[/list][list]
[*] UPDATED: Red Pearl icon design
[*] REVISED: Stone of Health description (Health replacing Vitality)
[*] FIXED: Smith's Sword quest item inventory slot issue
[/list]
[h3][BALANCE] Drop Rate Adjustments
[/h3][b]Harkoon Chest Modifications:[/b]
[list]
[*] ADDED: Lost Map drop chance
[*] REMOVED: 50K Silver Bar
[*] ADDED: 1M Silver Bar drop chance
[*] ADDED: 5M Gold Bar drop chance
[*] ADJUSTED: Overall drop rates
[/list]
[h2]Monster Drop Refinements:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] REMOVED FROM ZOMBIE: Frog Leg
[*] REMOVED FROM ZOMBIE GHOST: Frog Tongue
[/list]
[b]ADDED TO VENUS FLYTRAP:
[/b][olist]
[*] Frog Tongue
[*] Frog Leg
[/olist]
[b]FIXED: Duplicate Zombie Dog entries in Fabric Piece section
[/b]
[h2][b][NEW] Beta-Exclusive Items
[/b][/h2]
[h3]Elemental Shard:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] +50% item upgrade chance
[*] Available during Closed Beta only
[/list]
[h3]General Merchant Special Item:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] 40% increased loot chance
[*] Purchasable with Gold
[*] Limited to Beta testing period
[/list]
[h2]MOUNT SYSTEM
[/h2][b][BALANCE] Mount Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] REMOVED: All mount bonuses
[*] DISABLED: Combat while mounted
[*] FIXED: Mount removal from special item slot upon death/dismount
[*] IMPROVED: Mount and dismount functionality
[*] ENHANCED: Mount control responsiveness
[/list]
[h2]USER INTERFACE
[/h2][b][IMPROVEMENT] Visual Feedback System[/b]
[list]
[*] ENHANCED: Private message visibility and prominence
[/list]
[h2]IMPLEMENTED: Comprehensive color-coding system:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Teleporter NPCs: Purple/Magenta
[*] Wild Mobs: Red (Aggressive)
[*] Passive Creatures: Pale Red
[*] Clan Founders: Orange
[*] Merchants/Task Givers: Green
[*] Group Members: Orange
[*] Dead NPCs/Mobs: Gray
[/list]
[list]
[*] ADDED: Yellow highlighting for defeated monster names
[*] IMPROVED: Corpse name display duration
[/list]
[h2][NEW] Interface Features
[/h2]
[list]
[*] ADDED: ESC key functionality for closing all game windows
[/list]
[h3][b]IMPLEMENTED: Alternative loot keybinds:[/b]
[/h3][list]
[*] TAB
[*] 0
[*] `[/list]
[b][h3]ENHANCED: Item stacking behavior[/h3][/b]
[h3]IMPROVED: "Take All" functionality:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Proximity-based appearance
[*] Modified group loot interaction
[*] Optimized pickup mechanics
[/list]
[h2][FIX] UI Elements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Corrected quest indicators during character switching
[*] Fixed inventory display issues
[*] Resolved Atlas update problems
[*] Improved item collection feedback
[/list]
[h2]PROGRESSION SYSTEM[/h2]
[h3][b][BALANCE] Level Requirement Adjustments[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Mountain of the Cursed Warlord notification: Level 45 (↑5)
[*] Spider Catacombs notification: Level 145 (↑5)
[*] Zombie mob HXP cap: Level 72
[*] Group level difference requirement: Maximum 55 levels
[/list]
[h2][FIX] Experience Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Corrected unauthorized HXP/HP gains from high-level maps
[*] Fixed experience calculation issues
[*] Improved level-up notification timing
[*] Enhanced progression tracking
[/list]
[h2]BATTLEGROUND ARENA[/h2]
[h3][NEW] Comprehensive Team System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Maximum team size: 8 players
[/list]
[b]Team leader exclusive controls:[/b]
[list]
[*] Registration management
[*] Team enrollment/un-enrollment
[*] Random mode selection
[/list]
[h3]Automatic queue management:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removal upon group kick
[*] Level difference restrictions
[*] Team status tracking
[/list]
[h2][NEW] Game Modes
[/h2]
[h3]Last Man Standing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Support for up to 200 players
[*] Enhanced battle royale mechanics
[/list]
[h3]Standard Arena Modes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 40-player capacity
[*] Balanced team competition
[*] Various gameplay objectives
[/list]
[h3][IMPROVEMENT] Arena Management[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced queue system
[*] Improved team balance
[*] Refined matchmaking algorithm
[*] Updated arena boundaries
[/list]
[h2]TECHNICAL[/h2]
[h3][u][b][FIX] Critical Issues[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] RESOLVED: Console freezing during extended play
[*] FIXED: Black screen during game startup
[*] CORRECTED: Character respawn issues
[*] IMPROVED: Character switching stability
[*] FIXED: Game client performance issues
[/list]
[h2][OPTIMIZATION] Graphics & Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] ADJUSTED: HDR '[b]Natural Bloom[/b]' effect across multiple areas
[*] ENHANCED: Soul Effect VFX after creature deaths
[*] IMPROVED: Visual consistency
[*] FIXED: Pumpkin scaling uniformity
[*] OPTIMIZED: Texture loading
[*] ENHANCED: Particle effects
[/list]
[h2][FIX] Miscellaneous
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Corrected elixir usage when HP/MP bars are full
[*] Improved post-death item collection
[*] Enhanced Atlas updates during character changes
[*] Fixed quest tracking persistence
[/list]
[h2]KNOWN ISSUES
[/h2][h3][ACTIVE] Current Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Loot is not yours" message may appear during rapid collection
[*] Group loot VFX persistence
[*] Occasional texture loading delays
[*] Minor UI element overlapping
[/list]

[i][h3]Note: This update is part of our Closed Beta testing phase. Your feedback is crucial for further improvements. The Battleground arena system is completely open to all players during the beta period - please try it out and share your experiences! For detailed information about the Battleground arena system, please refer to our comprehensive guide.[/h3][/i]

[i][b][h3]For details of the patch notes, check out the patch-info channel on Discord.[/h3][/b][/i]
[url=https://discord.com/channels/751060360701673483/1336763202679345243][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/e7b33b5568c69e6702a2324aedd1ed9d76c1d40d.png[/img][/url]
[h2]
Regards,
PlayM2M[/h2]

notes.title: Final Beta Stress Test – Help Us Prepare for Early Access!
notes.content:
[h3][h1]Dear Players,[/h1]

We have observed that many of you do not actively engage in the closed beta due to progress not being retained, [u]often logging in briefly to explore before logging out.[/u] 

Only a small group of participants has provided constructive feedback. However, we assure you that the primary objective of this closed beta is to ensure a seamless and stable experience for the upcoming early access launch. 

Despite presenting what appears to be a fully developed game, we have received nearly [u]some of bug reports, all of which our team is diligently addressing[/u].

At this stage, we kindly ask for your support in one final test. To [u]complete our operational pipeline[/u] and stay on track for an early access launch by the end of March, we must conduct a large-scale stress test to ensure [u]our servers can efficiently scale to at least a few hundred concurrent users.[/u] This test is not meant to determine whether the servers will crash or become unresponsive but rather to verify that the system can handle average the expected connection load. 

Accordingly, Playtest access will be closed on Friday, February 10, 2025 at 23:59 CET and Playtest access will be reopened on
[list]
[*] [b]Friday, February 14, 2025, 18:00 CET[/b]
[/list]We ask that all players log in at the same time to create an important stress test. 

[h3]Even logging in for just one hour would greatly support our efforts. This test will provide us with critical data on the scalability and performance of our early access servers under high traffic conditions.

We sincerely appreciate your cooperation and commitment. We look forward to ushering in a new era of gaming with you in early access![/h3]

[h3]You can participate in the following survey to reset the servers and start anew or to preserve the progress, according to the results of the survey the servers will be reset or the progress will be preserved. [/h3]
[url=https://discord.com/channels/751060360701673483/1312266895243874304/1338625359041663018][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/e7b33b5568c69e6702a2324aedd1ed9d76c1d40d.png[/img][/url]

However, this only applies to the Playtest version, the server will be completely reset in early access, this will not change that.

Thank you for your support and understanding!

notes.title: Prank Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/5ef27ebb1add9a6094eef851259d6f8f85bbe3a7.png[/img][h1]24 December Prank Day Event[/h1]
[b]Drinking maniac Kenrush is now selling his special concoctions for a week. Find him and try the effects of the drinks! Kenrush is located in the Teleportation square, you can buy the following drinks from him for Spirit points:[/b]

In a realm where the most extraordinary enchanting potions were a rare gift from the Aravonuria Deity, one man's insatiable desire led to a fateful bargain with the forces of Light and Darkness. Centuries-old recipes, guarded by prestigious brewing families, held the key to crafting the most renowned elixirs. A humble potion maker once swore an oath before the powers of Light and Darkness, pledging anything in exchange for the fame associated with the most potent concoctions. While the Guardians of Light disregarded the mortal's petty ambitions, the Lords of Darkness listened to his pleas.

A dream was sent to the destitute man, foretelling that his soon-to-be-born child would possess a miraculous ability to create unparalleled potions. The child, as foretold, exhibited these skills at a young age. However, the father, growing increasingly impatient, relentlessly pushed his child to concoct ever more extraordinary brews.

Thus, elixirs enhancing magical abilities were born, quickly becoming the most sought-after concoctions in the father's potion shop. But with insatiable greed, the father coerced his child into creating new recipes. However, as the concoctions grew more exceptional, so did the child's detachment from reality, leading to increasingly peculiar behaviors. The townsfolk, witnessing the transformation, dubbed him the "foolish child."

Despite the warnings, the father persisted, extracting the two most extraordinary potions from his child: the Divine Master's Life Elixir and the Blessing of the Dragon. Yet, the moment the last potion was complete, the child's mind irreversibly shattered, finding solace only in songs, jokes, and entertaining the people.

On the day the child returned home wearing a jester's hat, singing ballads with an ever-present smile, the father realized the extent of his actions and the fate he imposed on his only child. He copied the recipes and distributed them across the empire, redistributing his wealth to the needy. His sole purpose became finding a cure for his child. By day, he silently watched over the child, and by night, he delved into ancient books seeking the healing recipe.

Meanwhile, in blissful ignorance, Kenrush lived his days. His cheerful songs, jokes, and stories brought laughter even to the grumpiest souls. Occasionally, he sneaked into the yards of potion masters, concocting funny brews that echoed with laughter throughout the courtyards.

The hearts of the Guardians of Light softened towards Kenrush. They bestowed blessings, and through the Dragon Deity's priests, declared that Kenrush's potions posed no harm or illness. Therefore, every year, under the supervision of the priests, Kenrush could sell his potions for a week, bringing joy even in troubled times. This annual event, celebrated in the spirit of merriment, was aptly named "Prank Day" by the inhabitants of the imperial city.

Kenrush could be found at Teleport Square, offering the following potions for Spirit points:

[list]
[*] [b]KaBOomm Elixir[/b]: Upon use, comic book bubbles appear on enemies when struck.  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/380f3e1635fe1f3af958f41e5bc3d26ff4d12ab8.png[/img]
[*] [b]Forbidden Elixir[/b]: Lose control over your character, mimics the experience of being drunk.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/ff316c9f0cd1c9518ab2995b55b9b7b1f927cd4d.png[/img][*] [b]Brobdingnagian Elixir[/b]: Increases your character's size twofold upon consumption. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/22514c5ba891228eb586be0bd9b6b17c0fdbf8ba.png[/img]
[*] [b]Lilliputian Elixir[/b]: Reduces your character's size by half when consumed.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/d89ec929b0e686dd3b755a3352d15d63170ffcbb.png[/img]
[/list]

The effects of these potions last for five minutes, after which they return to their original state. At the end of the event, the potions will be removed from the game, so only purchase what you intend to use!

You have already read the story of Kenrush. The annual related event is celebrated in the spirit of foolishness by the inhabitants of the imperial city, and the period is quickly dubbed "prank day".

May fun and pranks be at the heart of every adventurer this week!

M2M Team

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.5.6.3
notes.content:
The following changes were added during today's real-time maintenance!

[h1]Character abilities[/h1]

[list]
[*] Increased the recharge time of the Shaman Heal ability from 20 to 40 seconds.
[*] Increased the recharge time of the Shaman Lightning Claw ability from 15 to 20 seconds.
[/list]

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
[list]
[*] Optimized the [b]Wolf Shaman forest.[/b]
[*] Optimized the [b]Minotaur Fortress.[/b]
[*] Optimized the [b]Witch Queen Forest[/b].
[*] Optimized the [b]Lost Empire[/b]
[*] Optimized in the[b] Land of the Dead[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Greatly increased the amount of gold you can get from your opponents (all maps)
[*] Wildar, Eormenor and Mino's spirit chests now have optolos.
[*] Optolo gear is now more likely to be available from the Naga Queen and Spider Queen chests.
[*] The description of the gold bar now shows its value converted to gold.
[*] The price of optolos has been reduced by 50%
[*] The Cloak of Courage is now available for trade.
[*] Magic stone now gives a percentage mana bonus ( 10% - 30% )
[*] Defense Stone now gives a percentage defense bonus ( 10% - 30% )
[/list]

[h1]Battleground Arena
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Achievements in Battleground as well as trophies obtained by the character are now displayed as separate tabs in the Profile window.
[*] We have changed the small map that appears in the top right corner under the battlegrounds: - The entire battleground will be continuously visible. - The background of the small map can be removed using the eye icon in the top left corner.
[*] The elements of the group UI can now be moved, the settings UI can be unlocked and the original layout can be restored using the corresponding buttons.
[/list]

[h1]Issue Fixes
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Addressed an issue where Power Hunting losses and gains were not being recorded.
[*] Improved the clarity of the warning text when exiting Observer mode.
[*] Resolved a bug that allowed players to sign up for the Battlegrounds game mode, which is currently not permitted.
[*] Fixed the situation where players were being placed in one of the Battleground groups even as spectators.
[*] Corrected the display of actual values for wins and losses in the stats GUI.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused an uneven distribution when creating battles.
[*] Continuously updated the Battleground Observer Mode leaderboard.
[*] Closed a gap in Wolf-Shaman and the Harbor neighborhood.
[*] Enhanced the mechanism that refills the lives of bosses when they no longer perceive a threat.
[*] Improved Movement Speed bonuses to apply in all situations.
[*] Addressed the issue where typing long texts in chat would hide the full text until the window was resized.
[*] Fixed a bug where Intelligence was not properly affecting Petrun's Disable ability.
[*] Resolved the conflict where two Big Warehouse bonuses could be active simultaneously.
[*] Corrected the damage output of Shaman staffs' 2nd hit.
[*] Fixed the issue where the linked inventory would sometimes shift while moving.
[*] Adjusted the character menu button lighting to only appear when there is a skill or stat point ready to be deployed.
[*] Addressed various graphical issues in the Witch Queen's area.
[*] Fixed instances where characters would become stuck in demon gates, not attacking, and their health would constantly replenish.
[*] Prevented item loss when there was insufficient space to repack items during a withdrawn trade.
[*] Restored the music in the Witch Queen's Realm.
[*] Fixed a graphical bug that caused characters' faces to shatter while in hiding.
[*] Improved the reliability of the online GM list, ensuring that GMs consistently appear on the list and reflect their availability accurately.
[*] Resolved inaccuracies in the map placement of certain quest NPCs.
[*] Corrected the displayed attack value for the Petrun Flame Shards ability.
[*] Fixed a bug in Naga Run that caused the Minotaur ghost to slide on the ground instead of walking.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Master of Stone Evasion stone would give Defense instead of Dodge.
[*] Fixed a special fix has been implemented due to the game maps loading late. ([u]Required Steam update[/u])
[*] Fixed an issue where the icons of some power stones were duplicating each other.
[*] Fixed an issue with getting stuck on the login screen.
[*] Fixed a walking issue in the capital city due to a collider calculation issue. (Arena Stairs)
[*] Fixed an issue that caused remnants to remain on maps after events ended.
[/list]

[i]The game is finished, but the development is far from over. More exciting innovations are coming soon! Thank you for your signals, help and patience so far. We are counting on you in the future! We wish everyone a pleasant time in the world of Magic To Master![/i]

[b]NPC and Quest Improvements[/b]:
[list]
[*] "Market Place Manager" NPC's name has been changed to 'Market Place'.
[*] A special indicator has been placed on the 'Market Place' NPC's to indicate that it is related to trade.
[*] On the quarantine island, 'Healer' has been placed in the teleport area in the Capital for those who were unable to deliver the 'Report for Healer' quest.
[*] Fixed a quest bug that prevented access to King Guivre valley.
[*] Improved the design of the Petrun character.
[/list]

[b]Fixing In-Game Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug x8492E-CODE that caused the item to disappear when upgrading items.
[*] Fixed a signing bug that caused heclient.dll to be deleted on client startup (restart steam for this)
[*] A new setting has been selectively added to the "**ESC>Game options>target board**" tab so that when the target is right-clicked, their current rate will appear above the HP and Mana bars.
[*] Fixed a screen GUI bug x8491E-CODE related to PlayerHUD.
[*] Fixed a slippage in Sculp.
[*] Fixed a GUI bug overriding mouse sensitivity.
[*] Fixed a bug where the cursor would not appear in the game when you selected the original mouse cursor.
[*] Fixed a script bug that was blocking the countdown timer when you log in to Naga Run.
[/list]

[b]Difficulty Levels and Group Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Minotaur Run has been reduced from requiring a group of at least 4 people to 2 for playtest servers.
[*] Wuzhein Run has been reduced to 2 people for playtest servers, requiring a group of at least 5 people.
[*] Fixed a bug that increased the difficulty of the "Black Wolf" gangs on Quarantine Island and reduced them to normal level (they die easily now).
[/list]

[b]Various Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple bugs in English translations.
[*] Fixed a bug when adding stones to items (Armor and Weapons).
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing items (Armor and Weapons) to constantly break when adding gems.
[*] The limit of 5 character creation per account has been increased to 25 on playtest servers.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused ,,Black Wolf'' mobs on Quarantine Island to give 100% poisoning.
[*] Increased the XP and HeroPoint rates given out by ,,Black Wolf'' mobs on Quarantine Island.
[*] Caching speed of loading screens (loading_screen) has been increased. So you will be able to log in faster.
[*] PerCCU (per player) server calculation technical values have been upgraded to improve ping, lag and loss issues by 30.004%.
[*] The DirectX-based advanced optimization module has been installed on the server, so it now offers a better graphics-based display.
[/list]

notes.title: P.A.T.C.H Notes V.1.5.6.1
notes.content:
[b]Server & Network Version: v100.5H[/b]
[b]Client Version: E2.1.1[/b]
__ 

[b]Dear Players[/b]

We are excited to announce the latest patch for our beloved game, which includes exciting new content, improvements and bug fixes that will take your gaming experience to a whole new level! With the release of version 2.1.1, we truly value your feedback and support and hope these improvements will make your journey in the game more enjoyable and rewarding. Thank you for being part of our vibrant community! Stay tuned for more adventures and happy gaming!

- The base bonus values of some mobs have been changed.
- Some minor and major UI based changes have been implemented.
- Optimization and improvements to Lost Empire, Quarantine Island, Zorandor and a few other maps.
- Fixed bugs in some of the missions.
- Fixed a bug with no bonuses for items.
- Fixed a bug where the game camera would sometimes stay inside the wall.
- Fixed a bug where the "M" large map would open and not show NPC's.
- Fixed items that were supposed to be timed but their durations were not working.
- Fixed some translation bugs.
- Fixed a bug with animations (Petrun)
- Fixed a delay in animations (Mage)
- Fixed an issue with the Mage class not being able to deal damage.
- Replaced missing NPCs in the Wolf-Shaman forest, White witch queen empire, and Cursed Warlord map.
- Healer and Nurse have been placed in the Capital teleport arena for those who forgot to turn in the quest on Quarantine Island.
- Mixer not working on some maps in game soundtracks and sounds, will be updated.
- Due to an issue with some data not being cached in the game, update has been issued on Steam.
[b]NOTE:[/b ][u]The Steam update will reset your cache to store data cached by the remote repository on your computer. This is why your first login to the game after the update will be very, very slow. This is because it is trying to do caching. Remember that every time you visit a part of the game, if it is the first time, it will load very late. However, the second time it will load at its normal speed. You need to wait patiently for this.[/u]

[b]Please restart Steam for strong and healthy game communication.[/b]

We are with you on the adventure,
Your M2M Team
